description.value: Princeton Arena is a municipally operated ice facility in Princeton, BC, offering ice hockey and skating to the community. It is part of the Town of Princeton's parks and recreation network, which also includes a bike park, outdoor pool, and campground. A touring cyclist passing through Princeton might visit as a spectator or to use shared municipal facilities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Princeton Arena as a leisure=sports_centre with sport=ice_hockey;skating, operated by the Town of Princeton. The website (www.princeton.ca) is the municipal government site and lists the Arena under Parks & Recreation, but no dedicated arena subpage content was fetched, leaving amenity details unverifiable. The only contact data available from the website is the Town of Princeton's general phone numbers and mailing address, not arena-specific contacts.
concerns: No physical address for the arena is available — OSM and website only provide the Town Hall mailing address (P.O. Box 670).
